It is classified risky because a value typed into the wrong box is how a transfer acquires the wrong payee, and because the values are member data. subject: link "Primary Savings" within "Share and Deposit Accounts"
reason: policy heritage-core-default permits selectFromList (risky) on http://127.0.0.1:50922 — A selection reads the items a screen is currently offering and presses the one whose label matches the parameter, so it commits exactly what a click commits and is classified the same way. It is permitted because the alternative is recording one artifact per account type, which multiplies the number of documents a reviewer has to approve without reducing what any of them can do. What bounds it is that the match is a token subset of a label the screen itself offered, never a free-text instruction: a selection cannot reach a control the list does not contain, and an ambiguous match stops the run rather than choosing.

target: link "Primary Savings" within "Share and Deposit Accounts"
